description: This file defines the ClientService interface which declares methods for managing Client objects such as fetching, creating, updating, and deleting clients within the application.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves a Client object by its ID.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new Client object; may throw SnowmanException on failure.

methods.name: updateClient
methods.description: Updates an existing Client object; may throw SnowmanException on failure.

methods.name: deleteClient
methods.description: Deletes a Client identified by clientId; may throw SnowmanException on failure.
